scope: Selected librio terminal-state source and its in-repository dependency crates (rio-vt, rio-graphics, rio-fonts, rio-unicode, rio-grapheme-width), their manifests, the retained root workspace manifest and license notices. Kiln's independent web/herdr-viewer browser workspace builds these sources through Kiln-owned wrapper manifests under web/herdr-viewer/rio that point directly to the imported src/lib.rs files and omit upstream's PTY, image, glyph, renderer, window and clipboard features. librio's C ABI, librio-wasm's input-capable JavaScript ABI, the renderers, windowing and the Rio application are not imported or built.
nonclaims: This immutable local import is not remote publication, source authority, source trust, or release eligibility. Upstream declares rust-version 1.100.0 only at workspace level; no imported package inherits it, and Kiln builds the selected sources with its pinned browser toolchain without changing any upstream byte. A source checkout is needed only to reproduce the import, never to build Kiln.
manifest_normalization: Absent workspace members are pruned from the retained root manifest so Cargo can read the partial import without resolving unselected upstream producers.
formatter_scope: Tree-local rustfmt configuration sets disable_all_formatting so the host workspace formatter covers Kiln-owned sources without rewriting pinned upstream bytes.
